name: M$^2$E-UAV
description: Tiny UAV detection from an onboard event camera is difficult when the observer and target move at the same time. In this motion-on-motion regime, ego-motion activates background edges across buildings, vegetation, and horizon structures, while the UAV may appear as a sparse event cluster. Unlike static- or ground-observer event-based UAV detection, onboard UAV-view detection breaks the clean-background assumption because sensor ego-motion can activate dense background events over the entire field of view.
